solid_bars_above_the_baseline_show_compl: Solid bars above the baseline show completed work. Outlined bars below show incoming work. The thin line shows the completed running total. Exact values follow the chart.
missing_information_stays_blank_and_is_n: Missing information stays blank and is never counted as zero.
compared_with_the_previous_matching_peri: Compared with the previous matching period ({value1})
no_recorded_movement_in_this_period_59cf: No recorded movement in this period
solid_above_completed_outlined_below_inc: Solid above = completed · outlined below = incoming
allEstimated: Every remaining task has an estimate
targetMissing: No release target date is recorded
provisional: This date is provisional. It becomes more reliable as estimates and delivery evidence improve.
reason_no_planned_release: Plan a release before estimating its delivery range.
reason_insufficient_completion_history: More completed work is needed before pace can support a release forecast.
countingSemantics: Completed lines are current planned task estimates, not measured Git changes. Added lines include initial estimates and estimate increases; reductions and dropped work are excluded. Tests use recorded terminal summaries for this repository. Token totals come from providers; missing data remains missing. Forecasts are provisional ranges based on recent completion pace, current estimates, scope changes and test stability. Unestimated work uses the median recorded task size when available.
